items.description: Filing a stock record via the API persists a StockRecord with the exact SKU, location, quantity, and inventory_code supplied
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at the stock-filing route mounts the stock-filing page (not a fallback or 404)
the SKU input on the stock-filing form carries its design-guide data-testid attribute
the location input on the stock-filing form carries its design-guide data-testid attribute
the quantity input on the stock-filing form carries its design-guide data-testid attribute
the inventory_code input on the stock-filing form carries its design-guide data-testid attribute
submitting the stock-filing form with valid SKU, location, quantity, and inventory_code triggers a POST to the stock API endpoint
The boundary layer (app/routes/) does not import the database session object
The boundary layer (app/routes/) contains no ORM model imports
The service layer (app/services/) contains no ORM or session imports
DATABASE_URL is read from the environment variable and is not hardcoded anywhere in the application source
The service layer rejects a write whose quantity would be negative before any database interaction occurs
Attempting to insert a stock_records row with a null quantity is rejected by the database
Attempting to insert a stock_records row with a null sku is rejected by the database
Attempting to insert a stock_records row with a null location is rejected by the database
Attempting to insert a stock_records row with a null inventory_code is rejected by the database
A write that would store a negative quantity value in stock_records is rejected by the DB CHECK constraint and no negative row is persisted
The Alembic migration downgrade for stock_records completes without error in a single step
Rows seeded into stock_records before the migration upgrade are present with their original values after the upgrade completes
Retrieving a previously filed stock record via the API returns the exact quantity that was filed
Retrieving a previously filed stock record via the API returns the exact combined inventory_code that was filed
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at the stock-retrieval route mounts the stock-retrieval page (not a fallback or 404)
the retrieval page displays the quantity value returned by the API in the element carrying its design-guide data-testid
the retrieval page displays the inventory_code value returned by the API in the element carrying its design-guide data-testid
Filing stock a second time for the same SKU and location pair updates the existing record in place rather than creating a duplicate
Filing stock a second time for the same SKU and location pair returns a success response with no error surfaced to the caller
rendering <App> in MemoryRouter at the stock-filing route and submitting for a SKU+location pair a second time does not display an error message
after a second submission for the same SKU+location pair the form container carries its design-guide success-state class rather than an error-state class
Filing two records with the same (sku, location) pair results in exactly one row stored in stock_records
Concurrent writes for the same (sku, location) pair produce exactly one stored row with no integrity error surfaced to the caller
The created_at value of a stock_records row is unchanged after an in-place upsert on the same (sku, location) pair
